# UPTOME

> UPTOME(업투미)는 서울 연남동의 예약제 호주식 모던 다이닝 레스토랑입니다. 호주 식재료와 한국의 제철 재료를 활용해 일반식과 비건식 계절 코스를 선보입니다.

## Canonical website
- https://uptomeseoul.com/

## Core facts
- Korean name: 업투미
- English name: UPTOME
- Category: Australian modern dining restaurant
- Address: 서울특별시 마포구 성미산로 165-6, 1층
- English address: 1F, 165-6 Seongmisan-ro, Mapo-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea
- Hours: Daily 12:00–22:00, no break time
- Reservations: Advance booking
- Telephone: 010-7746-1288
- Menus: Regular seasonal course, vegan seasonal course, wine list
- Amenities: On-site parking, baby chair, pet-friendly terrace
- Group bookings: Hall up to 40 guests; terrace up to 26 guests
- Corkage: KRW 30,000 per bottle
